item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:50 HKT 21/Jun/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will continue to bring a few showers to the coast of southern China today. With an anticyclone aloft dominating the region, the weather will be generally fine and very hot over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea midweek next week, and edge closer to the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. More showers with isolated thunderstorms at first. Hot with sunny periods during the day.
